declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completion_pairwise_coprime
declarations.statement:
theorem completion_pairwise_coprime (d g u : ℕ) (h : g.Coprime u) :
    (g * GTail d 1 g u).Coprime (u ^ d) ∧
      (g * GTail d 1 g u).Coprime ((g + u) ^ d) ∧
      ((g + u) ^ d).Coprime (u ^ d)
declarations.elaborated_check:
DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completion_pairwise_coprime (d g u : ℕ) (h : g.Coprime u) :
  (g * DkMath.CosmicFormula.GTail d 1 g u).Coprime (u ^ d) ∧
    (g * DkMath.CosmicFormula.GTail d 1 g u).Coprime ((g + u) ^ d) ∧ ((g + u) ^ d).Coprime (u ^ d)
